title: Real provider transport produces a validated envelope

given.context: actual persisted Plant records filtered into AuthorizedPlantContext
given.executor: configured production DeepSeek or Gemini Agno model executor with valid credentials and explicit model id
given.definition: isolated test-only runtime_contract_smoke definition using the production assembler and executor; absent from production definition resolution

when.action: the project-owned AgentRuntimeService runs a single-competence agent and receives a valid speak candidate

then.message_envelope: valid schema version 1 with safe refs and authorization scope
then.forbidden: no downstream product-agent completion claim, production registration of the smoke definition, raw provider response, prompt history, reasoning, credentials, fake output, Bus event, or UI event
